title: not actionable notice: rule x indicated that a canonical reproducible form can be obtained ...

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

labels.name: team-ExternalDeps
labels.description: External dependency handling, remote repositiories, WORKSPACE file.

labels.name: bad error messaging
labels.description: Issues where users get stuck because they don't understand what they did wrong

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

Recently I get a lot of output like below in my builds
```
DEBUG: Rule 'org_golang_x_tools' indicated that a canonical reproducible form can be obtained by modifying arguments sha256 = "11629171a39a1cb4d426760005be6f7cb9b4182e4cb2756b7f1c5c2b6ae869fe"
DEBUG: Rule 'org_golang_x_sys' indicated that a canonical reproducible form can be obtained by modifying arguments shallow_since = "1547471016 +0000"
DEBUG: Rule 'org_golang_x_net' indicated that a canonical reproducible form can be obtained by modifying arguments shallow_since = "1547150550 +0000"
```

now sadly those are all inherited targets (from WORKSPACE), at least a git grep "org_golang_x_sys" does not show anything. It would be great to only show messages about targets that the user *can* fix.

### Bugs: what's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.

See e.g. https://buildkite.com/bazel/bazel-at-release-plus-incompatible-flags/builds/121#5df6012a-4031-4ee1-bc8c-52ab6233473f

### What operating system are you running Bazel on?

linux
